meta.name: update-skills
meta.description: Re-apply your installed skills to pull their latest code from upstream.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重新应用已安装的技能以拉取最新代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已安装多个技能并希望保持它们最新
copy.tagline_en: Re-apply installed skills to pull their latest code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have installed skills and want to keep them up-to-date

howto.what: 它帮你把已安装的技能更新到上游最新版。运行后先确认代码仓库是干净的,再列出已装技能让你勾选要更新哪些,然后逐个重新拉取并覆盖旧代码,最后跑测试、必要时重建容器镜像,并汇总结果。
howto.when: 在 Claude Code 里输入 `/update-skills` 时触发;若仓库有未提交改动,会提示你提交或暂存后停下,不执行更新。

say.text: 运行 /update-skills,把已装的技能更新到最新
say.note: 会先检查、列出可更新项让你勾选

say.text: 只更新 Slack 这一个技能,其他先不动
say.note: 多选时只勾 Slack 这一项

say.text: 都更新完后提醒我重启服务

howto.what_en: Updates installed skills to latest upstream code. Checks the repo is clean, lists installed skills, lets you pick which to re-apply, re-fetches each one's files, validates, rebuilds the container when needed, then reports the result.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type `/update-skills` in Claude Code. If the working tree has uncommitted changes, it tells you to commit or stash first and stops.

say_en.text: Run /update-skills and update all installed skills
say_en.note: It will list the updates and let you select

say_en.text: Only update the Slack skill for now
say_en.note: Check only Slack in the picker

say_en.text: Remind me to restart the service after updating
say_en.note: A restart loads the new code
